name: HYDRA-UMC-VOICE-UI
notes: Real v0 audio front-end (WAV loading + energy-gate voice activity detection, stdlib-only) and a real rule-based intent/entity parser over already-transcribed text. Neither is the real Whisper STT / neural TTS pipeline the README's roadmap describes - those need a real model dependency and are still future work (name says UI, role is closer to a voice service than a graphical UI).
